initialExam.title: SSC CPO Sub-Inspector 2026
initialExam.description: Central Police Organization exam for Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPF. Notification released 31 May 2026; application open till 30 Jun 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: General Intelligence & Reasoning (50Q), General Knowledge (50Q), Quantitative Aptitude (50Q), English (50Q). Paper-II: English Language & Comprehension (200Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Paper-II: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. PET/PST mandatory.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Paper-I (CBT) → PET/PST → Paper-II (CBT) → Medical → Document Verification
initialExam.jobRole: Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police & CAPF, ASI in CISF
initialExam.careerGrowth: SI → Inspector → DSP/ACP through promotions and departmental exams.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill application 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Uniform Allowance, Risk Allowance, Medical, Pension
